doc.title: Walter Booker and Jimmy Cobb interviewed by Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 30, 1995

title: Cobb on keeping time and energy in Nat Adderley's band
summary: Cobb's concept is keeping the time lively and inspiring soloists; Nat's high-energy band expects it every night.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Tell us about your concept of time and color.

Well my concept is just to try to keep it lively and keep the time together, and try to keep everybody inspired if possible. You know, try to help them through their improvisation. Just try to be there, be there for them. And you know, at all times. In this band they depend on it a lot. And every band I guess, you know, but this band has a lot of energy. I mean Nat’s band has a lot of energy, so he expects it every night.
So that’s I fell into that habit, which I think is a good habit.
